description: Switch vault branch. confirm: true when the working copy is dirty. A dirty v2 copy whose files differ from the target returns status conflict (model branch-switch) and does not switch, even with confirm: true. choice use_local keeps the working copy on that branch; choice use_remote loads the target. Both need confirm: true and neither writes git. Go back is not a tool. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

choice.description: Branch-switch conflict choice. use_local keeps the working copy. use_remote loads the target. Neither writes git. Both require confirm: true. Omit to preview; a file conflict returns status conflict and does not switch.

confirm.description: Required true when the working copy has uncommitted changes, and for choice use_local or use_remote

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_branch_switch
